resolvedFindings.finding: Goal narrative allowed RETURNED while the public Goal enum and physical check omitted it.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Seal one seven-state matrix with RETURNED in code, public API and database; distinguish legacy AT_RISK progress health from canonical lifecycle.

resolvedFindings.finding: Public Goal responses were not explicitly related to durable receipts and result-unknown polling.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Keep the closed Goal body and newly seal X-DWP-Command-Receipt-Id, exact replay headers and RESULT_UNKNOWN receipt polling.

resolvedFindings.finding: The legacy progress PUT could be misclassified as canonical createGoal and produce dual-path writes.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Classify it only as a preserved ACTIVE or AT_RISK progress adapter; canonical create and submit are separate sole writers for their operations and dual read or write is forbidden.

resolvedFindings.finding: PER-008 action metadata could be mistaken for a PER-009 handler or IAQ-038 ownership transfer.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Keep IAQ-038 and team-performance under PER-008 with action provenance only and no completion recount.

resolvedFindings.finding: Historical Succession V21 and PER-009 V9 design paths could be treated as active migration authority.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Record physical high-water V20, forbid V9 and historical Succession V21, and require a separate allocator supersession and V21 lease.

resolvedFindings.finding: The current v62 authorization products contain no canonical PEP-PER-010 or PEP-PER-011 route and action bindings.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Keep source authoring NO-GO and make a bounded transport plus central-authorization successor the sole next eligible action.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial carrier incorrectly required the configured owner-group weight total at single-goal draft creation, which could prevent sequential creation of multiple draft goals.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Create now validates only the individual decimal weight in [0,1]; submit validates the transaction-consistent current owner-group total as exactly 1.000000.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial carrier incorrectly described bodyless submit as appending a content revision.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Create alone inserts immutable revisionNo 1; submit preserves revisionNo and contentHash and changes only goalState and aggregateVersion under CAS. Returned-content editing requires a separate successor.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial carrier named seven authorization layers but did not seal the exact PEP-PER-010 and PEP-PER-011 register values.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both commands now carry exact source aliases, app entitlement, profile-duty pairs, canonical capabilities, resources, action, populations, field groups, purpose and PEP layers, and the validator compares them directly with the pinned register.

verifiedBoundaries: PER-009 owns only createGoal, submitGoal, exact Goal persistence, durable receipt linkage and PerformanceGoalCommitted.v1 production.
The authoritative Goal states are DRAFT, SUBMITTED, RETURNED, APPROVED, ACTIVE, COMPLETED and CANCELLED.
PER-009 implements only EMPTY to DRAFT and DRAFT or RETURNED to SUBMITTED.
Create If-Match literal zero and X-DWP-Command-Receipt-Id are explicitly new semantic seals rather than claims of existing runtime behavior.
The public Goal body remains goalId, goalState, revisionNo and aggregateVersion.
The event payload remains exactly goalId, ownerType, ownerPublicId, revisionNo and state.
Create validates individual weight only; submit validates the transaction-consistent owner-group total as exactly 1.000000.
Create inserts revisionNo 1 while submit preserves the existing immutable revision and only changes state plus aggregateVersion.
PEP-PER-010 and PEP-PER-011 exact authorization matrices equal the pinned register rather than generic layer labels.
Existing prf_command_receipts and prf_outbox_events are reused and not recreated.
The preserved personal-goal surface remains byte-pinned and receives no completion recount.
IAQ-038 remains owned by PER-008 and the receipt query remains owned by BASE-TFR-PER-011.
V21 is only a technical candidate; no lease, packet, token, worktree or source authority exists.
